en-US.title: FounderType
en-US.subtitle: Finish What You Start
en-US.description:
FounderType is a behavioral commitment system for people who keep starting things and stopping.

It identifies your specific founder pattern, puts one 30-day commitment on public record, and keeps the record honest through daily check-ins and accountability receipts.

FounderType is not a course, quiz, coaching app, or motivation feed. It is built for repeat starters who know what they should do and still keep walking away.

HOW IT WORKS

- Take a seven-question diagnostic
- Get a FounderType profile that names your stopping pattern
- Put one specific 30-day commitment on public record
- Check in daily with visible proof
- Receive accountability receipts that show whether you followed through or drifted

The friction is intentional. If you are not willing to put a commitment on record, FounderType is probably not for you.

FounderType helps you face the loop honestly, finish one real commitment, and stop treating quitting like a private event nobody can see.
